title: DBFlux redesign: Code snippets (#910) · dark
brief: Issue #910: user snippets with tabstop placeholders per query language. Settings section with list and form (built-in SQL snippets are editable and deletable), prefix completion with its own kind and a Tab/Shift+Tab field session in the editor, and a keybinding-driven Insert snippet picker with preview and empty states.

artboards.title: Settings › Snippets: list, form and states
artboards.tradeoff: Reuses the Hooks list + form so nothing new has to be learned; the body area is a code box, which is heavier than the Hooks inputs and needs the fields-tinted highlighting to explain ${1:table}.

artboards.title: Editor: prefix completion, field session and rules
artboards.tradeoff: Reuses the completion menu row exactly (one new kind word, no preview panel), so the snippet body is only seen after insertion; the dashed outlines make fields discoverable at the cost of some visual noise in the code.

artboards.title: Insert snippet picker with body preview
artboards.tradeoff: A wider overlay than the completion menu buys a body preview, which prefix completion cannot show; it adds a second way to insert, so its keybinding has to be discoverable in the palette.
